tools.name: list_restaurants
tools.description: The US restaurant chains Weight Class has menus for, with how many items each and the guide they come from. Each chain's numbers are its own published nutrition information.

tools.name: find_restaurant_items
tools.description: Items on one chain's menu with its own published calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber, sugars and sodium, filtered and sorted. Use it for questions like "high-protein orders at Chipotle under 600 calories" or "Starbucks drinks under 150 calories".

tools.name: search_restaurant_dishes
tools.description: Find a dish by name across the restaurant chains, e.g. "protein latte", "grilled chicken sandwich" or "burrito bowl", with each chain's own published numbers, closest names first. Optional limits on calories and protein, and a sort.

tools.name: lookup_food
tools.description: Calories, protein, carbs, fat and fiber of everyday foods from USDA FoodData Central (FNDDS): per 100 g, per household measure (1 cup, 1 large egg…), and for a weight you give.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search restaurant menu items at 100 US chains (each chain's own published numbers), the chains themselves and USDA foods. Returns results with an id, a title and a page; pass an id to fetch for the full numbers.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full nutrition numbers and source of one result from search: a restaurant item, a chain (its top meals by protein per calorie) or a USDA food.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
